verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs say traces can be exported via the UI or API, so trace export is a first-party capability. Nothing shows bulk export to blob storage or a data warehouse, or any dataset export at all. The OpenTelemetry Collector fanout describes routing traces on their way into tracing, not exporting from LangSmith, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk export to blob storage (e.g. S3/GCS), data warehouse destinations, dataset export, scheduling/format details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
